name: salesforce-crm
description: Connect your Salesforce CRM to Claude. Search, create, and manage leads, contacts, accounts, and opportunities. Log activities, run SOQL queries, and explore your Salesforce schema — all through natural conversation.
author: Emizentech

setup.instructions: Deploy mcp.php to your PHP server, configure Salesforce credentials as environment variables, then update the URL in .mcp.json to point to your server.
requirements: Salesforce org (Production, Sandbox, or Developer Edition)
Salesforce credentials (Username/Password/Token OR OAuth Connected App)
